construction: Measured interior tangent displacement of original iris-bearing eye surfaces; rear and outer rim fixed. Iris and sclera share original baked texture; no atlas redraw.
runtime: Normalize opposite gaze weights per eye; suppress gaze by (1-blink)^2 to preserve exact existing closure. L means character left. Horizontal Left is character left (+X).
limitations: Small bounded shifts, not eyeball rotation or independent iris anatomy.
Sclera pixels within interior transition move slightly with iris; rim, eyelids and lashes remain fixed.
mixing: Use either standard binocular controls OR per-eye variants, not both. Sum opposite weights <=1; clamp gaze vector to unit circle, multiply each eye by (1-blink)^2.
